types.name: HomeworkType

values.description: A written, prose response to a question

types.description: The type of homework being submitted

rules.alternateExpression: if hasFullName is false, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false
if hasStudentID is false, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false

if at least one of the following 2 statements is true: 1) submissionDate is greater than 0; 2) submissionDate is equal to 0 and submissionTime is greater than 23.59, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false
if submittedThroughPortal is false, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false
if homeworkType is equal to MATHEMATICAL_SOLUTION and showsIntermediateSteps is false, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false
if homeworkType is equal to WRITTEN_RESPONSE and wordCount is less than 250, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false
if homeworkType is equal to WRITTEN_RESPONSE and quotedMaterialPercentage is greater than 5, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false
if fileNameFollowsFormat is false, then isSubmissionAcceptable is false

rules.expression:
(= isSubmissionAcceptable
   (and (<= submissionDate 0)
        (<= submissionTime 23.59)
        fileNameFollowsFormat
        hasFullName
        hasStudentID
        submittedThroughPortal
        (=> (= homeworkType
               MATHEMATICAL_SOLUTION)
            showsIntermediateSteps)
        (=> (= homeworkType
               WRITTEN_RESPONSE)
            (and (> wordCount 250)
                 (< quotedMaterialPercentage
                    5.0)))))
rules.alternateExpression: isSubmissionAcceptable is equal to the following 8 statements are true: 1) submissionDate is no more than 0; 2) submissionTime is no more than 23.59; 3) fileNameFollowsFormat is true; 4) hasFullName is true; 5) hasStudentID is true; 6) submittedThroughPortal is true; 7) if homeworkType is equal to MATHEMATICAL_SOLUTION, then showsIntermediateSteps is true; 8) if homeworkType is equal to WRITTEN_RESPONSE, then wordCount is greater than 250 and quotedMaterialPercentage is less than 5.0

variables.name: hasFullName
variables.description: Indicates whether the homework submission includes the student's full name at the top of the first page

variables.name: hasStudentID
variables.description: Indicates whether the homework submission includes the student's ID number at the top of the first page

variables.name: submissionTime
variables.description: The time when the submission was received, expressed in 24-hour format (0.00-23.59). Don't translate 30 minutes into .5. For example, set a time of 23:30 to 23.3, not 23.5. The minimum value is 0 and the maximum value is 23.59

variables.name: submissionDate
variables.description: The date when the submission was received, relative to the due date (0 means on the due date, negative values mean before the due date, positive values mean after the due date)

variables.name: submittedThroughPortal
variables.description: Indicates whether the homework was submitted through the official school portal

variables.name: showsIntermediateSteps
variables.description: For mathematical solutions, indicates whether all intermediate calculation steps are shown

variables.name: wordCount
variables.description: For written responses, the total number of words in the submission

variables.name: quotedMaterialPercentage
variables.description: For written responses, the percentage of the submission that consists of quoted material (ranges from 0 to 100)

variables.name: fileNameFollowsFormat
variables.description: Indicates whether the file name follows the required format 'AssignmentNumber_LastName_FirstName'

variables.name: isSubmissionAcceptable
variables.description: Indicates whether the homework submission meets all requirements to be considered acceptable

variables.name: homeworkType
variables.description: The type of homework being submitted. Words like essay refer to a WRITTEN_RESPONSE.
